name: Kai
source:
[url=/c145784]Tsumi[/url]'s close friend and a flashy guy who is very popular with the girls because he's smart and handsome. Works part-time as a host and wishes to open his own host club in the future. He often hangs out with Tsumi, though they sometimes end up bickering.

[From [url=https://www.purplesoftware.jp/products/lipm/character.html]official website[/url]]
